authoring: Final Nov 9 evening dinners for Sun Nov 8 through Sat Nov 14, 2026. Sunday Vital frozen pizza (store-bought, already eaten). Monday Kevin's frozen teriyaki (store-bought). Tuesday garlic Parmesan chicken with side salad (chicken already on hand). Wednesday is pizza night (always). Thursday broccoli ham bake. Friday garlic butter steak bites. Saturday out of town (also away Sunday Nov 15). Egg roll in a bowl and pork carnitas dropped. No seafood. No nutrition figures.
household: Family of five. Home-cooked dinners are written for about 6 adult portions. Adults eat keto or low-carb. Kid starches are optional and listed on their own. Store-bought nights and away nights have no invented recipes. Wednesday is always pizza night.
